description: This file defines the DefaultCacheMonitor class, which implements ICacheMonitor and provides monitoring and metrics collection for cache-related activities in Orleans streaming infrastructure. It tracks cache size, message statistics, memory usage, and pressure status, exposing metrics via observables.

classes.name: DefaultCacheMonitor
classes.description: Implements cache monitoring for Orleans streaming, tracking cache size, message counts, memory, and pressure metrics.

classes.name: PressureMonitorStatistics
classes.description: Holds pressure monitor state, including pressure levels and dimensions.

methods.name: DefaultCacheMonitor
methods.description: Constructor initializing metrics counters and gauges based on provided dimensions.

methods.name: DefaultCacheMonitor
methods.description: Constructor that creates a DefaultCacheMonitor with a specific QueueId dimension.

methods.name: GetOldestToNewestAge
methods.description: Returns the age between the newest and oldest message enqueue times.

methods.name: GetOldestAge
methods.description: Returns the age of the oldest message in the cache.

methods.name: TrackCachePressureMonitorStatusChange
methods.description: Updates pressure monitor status, pressure contribution, and current pressure.

methods.name: ReportCacheSize
methods.description: Reports the current total cache size in bytes.

methods.name: ReportMessageStatistics
methods.description: Reports message enqueue/dequeue times and total message count, updating age metrics.
